name: ChatGPT
free_note: GPT-6 Luna; ads in the US and 31 European markets

name: Claude
free_note: Daily caps; the strictest free limits of the big three

name: Gemini
free_note: Most generous free tier; Gemini Flash with search, image generation

privacy: Trains by default with human review; turn off 'Keep Activity' to stop
